Runnable, robocode.robotinterfaces.IAdvancedEvents, robocode.robotinterfaces.IAdvancedRobot, robocode.robotinterfaces.IBasicEvents, robocode.robotinterfaces.IBasicEvents2, robocode.robotinterfaces.IBasicEvents3, robocode.robotinterfaces.IBasicRobot, robocode.robotinterfaces.IInteractiveEvents, robocode.robotinterfaces.IInteractiveRobot, robocode.robotinterfaces.IPaintEvents, robocode.robotinterfaces.IPaintRobot, robocode.robotinterfaces.ITeamEvents, robocode.robotinterfaces.ITeamRobot
public class SaorTwin extends robocode.TeamRobot
One twin of TwinSaor, the Twin Duel team (docs/twinsaor.md): the team file lists this class twice, and the first listed is the leader by the engine's rule (TWIN-1).

Every scan of an enemy is broadcast and then handled by the same path as the partner's (TWIN-5), so both twins hold the same record of both enemies and learn the same transitions (TWIN-6). The decisions are the core's (hadur117.twin.core); this class turns them into orders. Statics are per robot, because each robot has its own class loader, so the Markov tables are the only state kept from round to round.
